title: Business Gold Rewards Card: Travel Perks and Concierge Services
summary: Covers the Business Gold Rewards Card’s $200 annual travel credits (applied automatically for eligible travel bookings) and included concierge services for itinerary planning, multi-stop trips, dining reservations, and urgent changes via the concierge portal. Also states 0% foreign transaction fees and tips to confirm eligibility and keep confirmations for verification.
faqs: How much annual travel credit does my Business Gold Rewards Card account include?
When do travel credits apply, and do I need to request them?
What concierge services are included, and how do I submit a request?
Does the card charge a foreign transaction fee for international purchases?
What should I do before booking to make sure my travel purchase qualifies for credits?
